newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai exchange halts trade in 17 ailing firms.
newsitem.headline: Thai exchange halts trade in 17 ailing firms.

text.p: BANGKOK, Aug 5 (reuter) -The Stock Exchange of Thailand halted trading in 17 ailing publicly listed finance comnpanies on Tuesday afternoon, the bourse said in a statement.
The suspension came after the central bank governor announced that 42 ailing finance firms were to be suspended. Regulators have already suspended 16 ailing firms.

The listed firms among the 42 identified are: 1) Bangkok Investment Plc, 2) Cathay Finance and Securities Plc, 3) Ekapat Finance and Securities Plc, 4) Krung Thai Finance and Securities Plc, 5) Kiatnakin Finance and Securities Plc, 6) Multi Credit Corporation of Thailand Plc, 7) Nithipat Capital Plc, 8)Pacific Finance and Securities Plc, 9) Poonpipat Fionance and Securities Plc, 10) Siam City Credit Finance and Securities, 11) SCF Finance and Securities Plc, 12) Sri Dhana Finance and Securities Plc, 13) SITCA Investment and Securities, 14) Thai Financial Syndicate Plc, 15) Thaimex Finance and Securities Plc, 16) Thai Thanakorn Finance Plc, 17) Wall Street Finance and Securities Plc.
